reviewRules: Do not flatten food terms into generic translations.
Preserve cuisine context and local food meaning.
Treat dish names, cooking methods, and local food names as terminology, not ordinary prose.
Do not translate product names marked translate=false in the glossary.
Translate search examples by intent, not only by surface wording.
Keep Singapore-specific feature names explicit unless a language-specific style guide says otherwise.
